usedFor: TRIGGERcmd knows your computers, and Asana tracks the follow-up when “Computer Created” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “Computer Created” in TRIGGERcmd, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A newly added computer gets an Asana task, so setup steps have an owner and a date.

watchOut: “Computer Created” is polling, so the Asana task appears after a scheduled check.
